bio: The view of the River Meuse and its lush green banks immediately catches the eye as you enter Moma. Olivier Bruckner reveals his flair for enhancing each dish with subtle details, like a sweet-sour tomato and rich creamy burrata which provide the perfect foil to lacquered calf sweetbread. The menu features classical and gastronomic recipes, all of which are enticingly displayed thanks to inspired plating and at gloriously eater-friendly prices....
